text.remarks: Registers the grant of the village Oṇḍūru in the Handi- khaṇḍa subdivision of Honnāvara-mahārājya to Śa- nkarāya, son of Basavaṇa of the Viśvāmitra gōtra, well- versed in the Rig-vēda, for offerings to God Mahābalē- śvara at Gōkarṇa and maintenance of chhatra at the time of Rudrābhishēka and for expenses towards employing hands for cooking, conducting religious rites etc. The grant was made by the king at the instance of Ammappa- nāyaka, son of Khaļi-Jaya Chennappa-nāyaka.
